dimensions.assessment: Grants the Inspector General expanded investigative authorities while barring the reopening of final benefit decisions unless a court conviction occurs.

Amends chapter 53 of title 38 to mandate new recurring audits, notification procedures, reporting mechanisms, and Inspector General powers.

dimensions.assessment: Creates permanent administrative duties including recurring audits and annual congressional reporting.
dimensions.evidence: On an annual basis, the Secretary shall submit to the Committees on Veterans' Affairs... a report on the administration this section.
